seats.text: Fixed `dates.ts`: the loop condition `t < e` excluded the end date, so I changed it to `t <= e` to make the range inclusive. The existing validation (regex format check, UTC parse, ISO round-trip to reject impossible dates, and `s > e` check) was already correct. Verified with assertions covering full ranges, single-day ranges, leap-day boundaries, impossible dates, malformed input, and start>end. The room (seat-1/2/3) independently converged on the same fix and the proposal was accepted unanimously.
